content:
The task was successfully completed by using openpyxl to populate a multi-sheet Excel audit report while preserving template integrity.
The planner used openpyxl to load the template, ensuring the 'Overview' sheet remained intact while writing to 'RawData', 'Formatted Data', and 'Summary'. Explicit mapping of the first 8 columns ensured schema consistency, while derived columns 9-12 were written as concrete values to avoid formula errors. The final 'Summary' sheet correctly identified exceptions by grouping by Route and Shipment ID and filtering for Total Errors > 0.
